quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q, Q1 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended July 5, 2026): Network & Infrastructure Solutions segment operating earnings were $45.0 million (10.5% of net sales) versus $29.9 million (7.7%) a year earlier, up 50.4%; year-ago NIS net sales were $391.4 million. The new reportable segments (Network & Infrastructure Solutions, Industrial Mobility Solutions, Precision Power Solutions) replaced Energy Systems, Motive Power and Specialty, with goodwill reassigned as of May 28, 2026. Q1 capital expenditures were $12.4 million versus $33.0 million.
